package.author: 朱天雨
package.description: 免费开源的 Windows 桌面整理工具，提供原生质感的 WinUI 3 小组件。

en-US.description: A free, open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets.
en-US.longDescription: DeskBox is a free, open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets. It organizes desktop files, maps existing folders, and keeps everyday tools close without replacing Explorer or changing how your files work. Its real-folder-backed widgets make it a modern open-source alternative to tools such as Stardock Fences, while todos, quick notes, search, weather, and music controls remain useful extras. DeskBox uses Mica and Acrylic materials, stores everything locally, and ships x64 and ARM64 builds in more than a dozen interface languages.
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Date: 2026-10-14
- Version: 1.5.8
- Tag: v1.5.8
Highlights
- More accurate administrator notices. The notice now appears only when DeskBox runs above the shell. When it appears, one click exits the elevated instance and the notice walks through restarting with normal privileges — including how to clear a shortcut's "Run as administrator" checkbox. Autostart continues to restart silently with normal privileges. All 12 languages.
- Updates keep the shell's level. The updater restarts the app at Explorer's own privilege level whenever the shell offers a standard-user context, so machines that ran elevated no longer relaunch as administrator after a one-click update.
- Usable under an elevated Explorer. With Explorer running above DeskBox, the reveal hotkey and settings stay reachable, an explanatory notice replaces the untranslated failure box, and the rare fatal-startup message is localized with its diagnosed causes.
- Maintenance wave. Todo drag crash, stacked-icon loss on group switch, subfolder cut-and-paste hang, auto-organization rules being disabled by restart, logon restart loops on crashing desktops, the update-failure dialog collision, shortcut run-as detection in diagnostics, and terminability of relaunched instances.

zh-CN.author: 朱天雨
zh-CN.description: 免费开源的 Windows 桌面整理工具，提供原生质感的 WinUI 3 小组件。
zh-CN.longDescription: DeskBox 是一款免费、开源的 Windows 桌面整理工具，借助原生质感的 WinUI 3 小组件整理桌面文件：它把桌面文件收纳进小组件、映射已有文件夹，并让常用工具触手可及，而不会取代资源管理器或改变文件本身的工作方式。基于真实文件夹的小组件使其成为 Stardock Fences 等工具的现代开源替代品，待办、快速便签、搜索、天气和音乐控制等实用功能与之相辅。应用支持 Mica 与 Acrylic 材质，本地优先存储，提供 x64 与 ARM64 版本及十余种界面语言。
zh-CN.name: DeskBox
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
DeskBox 1.5.8 让 DeskBox 与资源管理器保持在同一完整性级别，无法保持时给出准确说明。全桌面提权的电脑（含公司统一管理机）不再显示管理员提示——这些环境下拖放功能本就正常；提示出现时，可一键退出当前实例并按步骤以普通权限重新打开，其中包含取消快捷方式"以管理员身份运行"勾选的方法。一键更新按资源管理器的权限级别重启应用，提权电脑更新后不再以管理员身份回来。资源管理器以管理员运行时应用保持可用（唤出热键与设置继续工作），诊断还能识别快捷方式级"以管理员身份运行"勾选。
发布信息
- 日期： 2026-10-14
- 版本： 1.5.8
- 标签： v1.5.8
主要更新
- 更准确的管理员运行提示。 提示只在 DeskBox 以高于资源管理器的权限运行时出现；出现时可一键退出并按步骤以普通权限重新打开（含取消快捷方式管理员勾选的方法）。开机自启继续静默以普通权限重启。全部 12 种语言。
- 更新保持 Shell 级别。 只要资源管理器提供标准用户环境，更新器就按其权限级别重启应用。
- 资源管理器提权时保持可用。 唤出热键与设置继续工作，说明弹窗替代未本地化的错误提示。
- 维护波次。 待办拖拽崩溃、切组丢叠放图标、子目录剪切粘贴卡死、自动整理规则跨重启保持、登录重启循环、更新失败弹窗冲突、快捷方式管理员勾选诊断、重启实例的可终止性。
